signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use the email and password of your {app} account.
signIn.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.

verify.title: Check your messages
verify.body: This device is new to your account. We sent a 6-digit code to {channel} for {email}.

validation.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.
validation.code: Enter the six-digit code from your email.

pin.createBody: You will use it to open {app} on this device. It never leaves this device.
pin.weak: That PIN is easy to guess. Choose another.
pin.mismatch: PINs did not match. Start again.

biometrics.title: Unlock with {method}
biometrics.body: Open {app} faster. Your PIN still works anytime.

notificationsIntro.title: Stay in the loop
notificationsIntro.body: Get notified about activity and security alerts. You can change this anytime in Settings.

unlock.title: Enter your PIN
unlock.forgotBody: Sign in again with your email and password, then create a new PIN.
unlock.wrongPinLast: Wrong PIN. 1 try left before you are signed out.
unlock.lockedOutBody: The PIN was entered wrong {attempts} times. Sign in with your password to set a new PIN.

closed.deactivatedBody: This account is switched off for now, so you can't sign in or use it.
closed.bannedBody: You can no longer sign in to this account.
closed.contact: If you think this is a mistake, contact support.

home.cardBody: This is the starter home screen. Replace it with your project's first feature.

notifications.title: Activity
notifications.emptyBody: Activity and notifications will show here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoLock: Locks after {seconds} s in the background
settings.signOutBody: You will need your email and password to sign in again on this device.

crash.title: {app} closed unexpectedly
crash.body: Sorry about that. Send the technical details so the team can fix it.
crash.failed: The report could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.

errorScreen.title: Something went wrong
errorScreen.body: This screen hit a problem. Your data is safe.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.offline: You're offline. Check your mobile data or Wi-Fi and try again.
errors.network: No internet connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.timeout: The request took too long. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.session_expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.staff_not_allowed: Staff accounts can't use the mobile app. Sign in on the web instead.
errors.http_401: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.http_500: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.http_503: The service is busy. Please try again in a moment.
